## 1. EnemyCombat.cs

### Full content

using UnityEngine;

public class EnemyCombat : MonoBehaviour
{
    [Header("攻击数值")]
    public int damage = 1;
    public float knockBackForce = 1.5f;
    public float stunTime = 0.5f;
    public float attackRange = 1.5f;
    public float attackCooldown = 1.5f;

    [Header("引用")]
    public PlayerHealth playerHealth;
    public PlayerMove playerMove;

    private EnemyMovement enemyMovement;
    private float lastAttackTime = -10f;

    void Start()
    {
        enemyMovement = GetComponent<EnemyMovement>();
    }

    public bool TryAttack()
    {
        if (Time.time - lastAttackTime < attackCooldown) return false;

        lastAttackTime = Time.time;
        return true;
    }

    public void Damage()
    {
        if (enemyMovement.Player == null) return;

        float distance = (enemyMovement.Player.position - transform.position).magnitude;

        if (playerHealth == null)
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("玩家的PlayerHealth组件未找到！", this);
            if (enemyMovement.Player != null)
            {
                playerHealth = enemyMovement.Player.GetComponent<PlayerHealth>();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (distance <= attackRange)
        {
            playerHealth.ChangeHealth(-damage);
            Debug.Log($"敌人攻击玩家，造成{damage}点伤害");
            playerMove.KnockBack(transform, knockBackForce, stunTime);
        }
    }
}
```

### Class & inheritance
- `public class EnemyCombat : MonoBehaviour` (Unity component).

### Key public fields
| Field | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `damage` | int | Damage dealt per hit (default 1) |
| `knockBackForce` | float | Force applied to player when hit (1.5) |
| `stunTime` | float | Duration player is stunned (0.5s) |
| `attackRange` | float | Max distance for a hit to connect (1.5) |
| `attackCooldown` | float | Seconds between allowed attacks (1.5) |
| `playerHealth` | PlayerHealth | Cached ref to player's health script |
| `playerMove` | PlayerMove | Cached ref to player's movement script |

### Design patterns / issues
- **Cooldown pattern:** `TryAttack()` gates attacks by comparing `Time.time` against `lastAttackTime` (`lastAttackTime = -10f` so first attack is instant).
- **Late self-healing reference:** In `Damage()`, if `playerHealth` is null it fetches it from the player transform but then `return`s — so the hit that triggered lookup deals **no damage that frame**; it only "repairs" the reference for next time. This is arguably a bug (should re-run or not return).
- **Potential NRE:** `playerMove.KnockBack(...)` is called without a null check on `playerMove`. If `playerMove` is not assigned in the Inspector, this throws `NullReferenceException` *after* damage has already been applied.
- Distance uses `.magnitude` (per-frame sqrt); `sqrMagnitude` would be cheaper — minor perf nit.
- Log message is in Chinese, consistent with the project (zh-CN environment).

using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

public class EnemyHealth : MonoBehaviour
{
    public int currentHealth = 10;
    public int maxHealth = 10;
    public int expValue = 3;
    public Image Image;
    public GameObject BloodUI;

    public event Action<int> OnDeath;
    public static event Action<int> OnAnyEnemyDeath;

    private void Start()
    {
        currentHealth = maxHealth;
    }

    public void ChangeHealth(int amount)
    {
        currentHealth += amount;
        if (currentHealth > maxHealth) currentHealth = maxHealth;

        if (currentHealth <= 0)
        {
            currentHealth = 0;
            OnDeath?.Invoke(expValue);
            OnAnyEnemyDeath?.Invoke(expValue);
            gameObject.SetActive(false);
            BloodUI.gameObject.SetActive(false);
        }

        Image.fillAmount = (float)currentHealth / maxHealth;
    }
}
```

### Class & inheritance
- `public class EnemyHealth : MonoBehaviour`.

### Key public fields
| Field | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `currentHealth` | int | Current HP (default 10) |
| `maxHealth` | int | HP cap (default 10) |
| `expValue` | int | EXP awarded on death (3) |
| `Image` | UnityEngine.UI.Image | HP bar fill image |
| `BloodUI` | GameObject | Blood/health-bar UI container to hide on death |
| `OnDeath` | event Action\<int\> | Instance-level death event with exp |
| `OnAnyEnemyDeath` | static event Action\<int\> | Global static death event (subscribed by `ExpController`) |

### Design patterns / issues
- **Event/observer pattern:** static `OnAnyEnemyDeath` lets `ExpController` listen to every enemy death without wiring per-instance in the Inspector. Subscribed in `Start`, unsubscribed in `OnDestroy` (good practice, avoids leaks).
- **Bug — `Image` may be null:** `Image.fillAmount = ...` is executed **after** the death branch may have run `gameObject.SetActive(false)` — but the null check is absent entirely. If `Image` is not assigned, every `ChangeHealth` call NREs (worse: it happens even when the enemy dies, after it was already deactivated).
- **Bug — `BloodUI` NRE:** `BloodUI.gameObject.SetActive(false)` assumes `BloodUI` is assigned.
- **Non-deductive damage logic:** Negative amounts work for damage, but positive amounts are clamped to `maxHealth` (fine), and there is no "die" state — just deactivation. `currentHealth = maxHealth` in `Start()` overrides any Inspector-set non-default value.
- `BloodUI.gameObject.SetActive(false)` — calling `.gameObject` is redundant (BloodUI already is a GameObject) — harmless minor.
- After death the enemy is only `SetActive(false)`, never destroyed — pooling-friendly, but memory stays allocated per scene.

## 3. EnemyMovement.cs

### Full content
```csharp
using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

public enum EnemyState
{
    Stand = 0,
    Chase = 1,
    Attack = 2,
}
public class EnemyMovement : MonoBehaviour
{
    private float distance = 10;
    public float speed = 2;
    public Animator enemyAnim;
    public EnemyCombat enemyCombat;
    private Transform player;
    private Rigidbody2D rb;
    private int facingDirection = 1;
    private bool enmity;
    private bool isAttacked = false;
    EnemyState state = EnemyState.Stand;

    public Transform Player => player;

    void Start()
    {
        rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
        enemyCombat = GetComponent<EnemyCombat>();
        facingDirection = transform.localScale.x > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    }

    void Update()
    {
        if (!isAttacked)
        {
            if (player != null) distance = (player.position - transform.position).magnitude;

            if (state != EnemyState.Attack && distance <= enemyCombat.attackRange)
            {
                if (enemyCombat.TryAttack())
                {
                    state = EnemyState.Attack;
                    rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
                }
            }
            else if (state == EnemyState.Chase)
            {
                ChaseTurn();
            }
            else if (distance > enemyCombat.attackRange && enmity == true)
            {
                state = EnemyState.Chase;
            }

            ToAnimator();
        }
    }

    private void OnTriggerEnter2D(Collider2D collision)
    {
        if (collision.gameObject.tag == "Player")
        {
            if (player == null)
            {
                player = collision.transform;
            }
            state = EnemyState.Chase;
            enmity = true;
        }
    }

    private void OnTriggerExit2D(Collider2D collision)
    {
        if (collision.gameObject.tag == "Player")
        {
            state = EnemyState.Stand;
            enmity = false;
            player = null;
            rb.velocity = new Vector2(0, 0);
        }
    }

    void ChaseTurn()
    {
        Vector2 direction = (player.position - transform.position).normalized;
        if (player.position.x < transform.position.x && facingDirection == 1)
        {
            Turn();
        }
        else if (player.position.x > transform.position.x && facingDirection == -1)
        {
            Turn();
        }
        rb.velocity = direction * speed;
    }

    public void ResetToStand()
    {
        state = EnemyState.Stand;
        rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
    }

    private void ToAnimator()
    {
        enemyAnim.SetInteger("EnemyState", (int)state);
    }

    void Turn()
    {
        facingDirection *= -1;
        transform.localScale = new Vector3(transform.localScale.x * -1, transform.localScale.y, transform.localScale.z);
    }

    public void KnockBack(Transform player, float force, float stunTime)
    {
        isAttacked = true;
        Vector2 direction = (transform.position - player.position).normalized;
        rb.velocity = direction * force;
        StartCoroutine(UnlockedMove(stunTime));
    }

    IEnumerator UnlockedMove(float stunTime)
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(stunTime);
        rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
        isAttacked = false;
    }
}
```

### Class & inheritance
- **`public class EnemyMovement : MonoBehaviour`**, plus a top-level **`public enum EnemyState { Stand=0, Chase=1, Attack=2 }`** in the same file.

### Key public members
| Member | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `speed` | float | Chase speed (2) |
| `enemyAnim` | Animator | Enemy animator (Exposed, not auto-fetched) |
| `enemyCombat` | EnemyCombat | Cached in `Start()` via GetComponent (redundant with public field) |
| `Player` | Transform (property) | Exposed read-only player ref (used by `EnemyCombat.Damage()`) |

### Design patterns / issues
- **FSM-lite:** simple Stand/Chase/Attack state machine driven by distance and trigger area. States drive animator via `enemyAnim.SetInteger("EnemyState", ...)`.
- **Bug — `enemyAnim` can be null:** `ToAnimator()` calls `enemyAnim.SetInteger` with no null check; if the animator isn't assigned, every frame throws NRE.
- **Logic hole — standing attack:** `Attack` state never transitions back. `ResetToStand()` exists but is never called anywhere in the codebase (dead method). If the player stays in range, `state` remains `Attack` but `Update` re-enters the first branch since `state != Attack` guard prevents it — so after the first attack, enemy stays in `Attack` state until player leaves trigger, then `OnTriggerExit2D` resets to Stand.
- **After attack the enemy never chases again while staying within the same trigger** — the `Attack` branch doesn't set `enmity` or chunks. When player walks out, trigger resets it, but if the player stays inside range, only one attack is done and no second attempt (state stuck in Attack).
- **`ChaseTurn` direction vector**: moving directly toward player in all directions, fine for 2D top-down.
- **Knockback pattern:** same coroutine-based "lock movement" as `PlayerMove` — `isAttacked` flag suppresses all Update logic while stunned.
- **Tag comparison:** uses `collision.gameObject.tag == "Player"`; Unity recommends `CompareTag` (allocates less, avoids exceptions for missing tags).
- `distance` initialized to 10 — is it preset to equal default `attackRange`? Not necessarily; before player enters trigger, `distance` 10 > attackRange 1.5, so fine.
- Start() sets `facingDirection` from `transform.localScale.x` — assumes initial flip in Inspector rather than rotation.

using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Unity.VisualScripting;
using UnityEngine;

public class PlayerCombat : MonoBehaviour
{
    public Animator playerAnim;
    public float cooldown=2;//冷却时间
    private float timer = 0;//倒计时器  
    public EnemyHealth enemyHealth;
    public Transform attackPoint;
    public LayerMask enemyLayer;
    public EnemyMovement enemyMovement;
    private void Update()
    {
        if (timer > 0)
        {
            timer -= Time.deltaTime;
            
        }
    }


    public void Attack()
    {
        if (timer <= 0)
        {
            playerAnim.SetBool("isAttack", true);
            timer = cooldown;
        }
    }
    public void FinishAttack()
    {
        playerAnim.SetBool("isAttack", false);
    }
    public void DealDamage()
    {
        Collider2D[] enemies = Physics2D.OverlapCircleAll(attackPoint.position, StatsManager.Instance.weaponRange, enemyLayer);
        if (enemies.Length > 0)
        {
            enemies[0].GetComponent<EnemyMovement>().KnockBack(transform, StatsManager.Instance.KnockBackForce, StatsManager.Instance.stunTime);
            enemies[0].GetComponent<EnemyHealth>().ChangeHealth(-StatsManager.Instance.damage);
            Debug.Log("造成伤害");

        }

    }
    private void OnDrawGizmosSelected()
    {
        if (attackPoint == null) return;
        Gizmos.color = Color.red;
        Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(attackPoint.position, StatsManager.Instance.weaponRange);
    }

}
```

### Class & inheritance
- **`public class PlayerCombat : MonoBehaviour`** — Unity component.

### Key public fields
| Field | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `playerAnim` | Animator | Player animator (to trigger attack animation) |
| `cooldown` | float | Attack cooldown (2s) |
| `enemyHealth` | EnemyHealth | Unused in DealDamage (dead field) |
| `attackPoint` | Transform | Center of the swing hit circle |
| `enemyLayer` | LayerMask | Which layers the attack can hit |
| `enemyMovement` | EnemyMovement | Unused in DealDamage (dead field) |

### Design patterns / issues
- **Animation-event-driven attack:** `Attack()` only starts animation and timer; actual damage is dealt when `DealDamage()` is called — presumably by an **animation event** inserted on the attack clip (typical pattern). `FinishAttack()` is the matching tail event.
- **Cooldown via timer decrement** in `Update()` (fine).
- **Bug — dead fields:** `enemyHealth` and `enemyMovement` are declared public, never assigned to in gameplay and never used in `DealDamage` (which fetches components itself via `GetComponent`). Confusing API.
- **Bug — `enemies[0]` only:** `OverlapCircleAll` may return multiple enemies, but only `enemies[0]` receives damage/knockback — no AoE even though the name/nature suggests all in radius. Possibly intentional (single target), but likely a bug for multi-hit expectations.
- **Potential NRE:** `enemies[0].GetComponent<EnemyMovement>()` — if the first collider belongs to a non-enemy (e.g., an object without `EnemyMovement`) NRE. LayerMask filters tag but not component absence.
- **No event hook for damage:** `DealDamage()` has no null check on `attackPoint` — but `OnDrawGizmosSelected` guards null first.
- **Bug — KnockBack origin:** `KnockBack(transform.position, ...)` — passes `transform.position` as the "player" position from which the knockback direction is computed. Since the attack originates at `attackPoint` and can hit any direction, using the player transform rather than `attackPoint` is a minor knockback-direction inaccuracy.

using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

public enum EnemyState
{
    Stand = 0,
    Chase = 1,
    Attack = 2,
}
public class EnemyMovement : MonoBehaviour
{
    private float distance = 10;
    public float speed = 2;
    public Animator enemyAnim;
    public EnemyCombat enemyCombat;
    private Transform player;
    private Rigidbody2D rb;
    private int facingDirection = 1;
    private bool enmity;
    private bool isAttacked = false;
    EnemyState state = EnemyState.Stand;

    public Transform Player => player;

    void Start()
    {
        rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
        enemyCombat = GetComponent<EnemyCombat>();
        facingDirection = transform.localScale.x > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    }

    void Update()
    {
        if (!isAttacked)
        {
            if (player != null) distance = (player.position - transform.position).magnitude;

            if (state != EnemyState.Attack && distance <= enemyCombat.attackRange)
            {
                if (enemyCombat.TryAttack())
                {
                    state = EnemyState.Attack;
                    rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
                }
            }
            else if (state == EnemyState.Chase)
            {
                ChaseTurn();
            }
            else if (distance > enemyCombat.attackRange && enmity == true)
            {
                state = EnemyState.Chase;
            }

            ToAnimator();
        }
    }

    private void OnTriggerEnter2D(Collider2D collision)
    {
        if (collision.gameObject.tag == "Player")
        {
            if (player == null)
            {
                player = collision.transform;
            }
            state = EnemyState.Chase;
            enmity = true;
        }
    }

    private void OnTriggerExit2D(Collider2D collision)
    {
        if (collision.gameObject.tag == "Player")
        {
            state = EnemyState.Stand;
            enmity = false;
            player = null;
            rb.velocity = new Vector2(0, 0);
        }
    }

    void ChaseTurn()
    {
        Vector2 direction = (player.position - transform.position).normalized;
        if (player.position.x < transform.position.x && facingDirection == 1)
        {
            Turn();
        }
        else if (player.position.x > transform.position.x && facingDirection == -1)
        {
            Turn();
        }
        rb.velocity = direction * speed;
    }

    public void ResetToStand()
    {
        state = EnemyState.Stand;
        rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
    }

    private void ToAnimator()
    {
        enemyAnim.SetInteger("EnemyState", (int)state);
    }

    void Turn()
    {
        facingDirection *= -1;
        transform.localScale = new Vector3(transform.localScale.x * -1, transform.localScale.y, transform.localScale.z);
    }

    public void KnockBack(Transform player, float force, float stunTime)
    {
        isAttacked = true;
        Vector2 direction = (transform.position - player.position).normalized;
        rb.velocity = direction * force;
        StartCoroutine(UnlockedMove(stunTime));
    }

    IEnumerator UnlockedMove(float stunTime)
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(stunTime);
        rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
        isAttacked = false;
    }
}

### Class & inheritance
- **`public class EnemyMovement : MonoBehaviour`**, plus a top-level **`public enum EnemyState { Stand=0, Chase=1, Attack=2 }`** in the same file.

### Key public members
| Member | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `speed` | float | Chase speed (2) |
| `enemyAnim` | Animator | Enemy animator (Exposed, not auto-fetched) |
| `enemyCombat` | EnemyCombat | Cached in `Start()` via GetComponent (redundant with public field) |
| `Player` | Transform (property) | Exposed read-only player ref (used by `EnemyCombat.Damage()`) |

### Design patterns / issues
- **FSM-lite:** simple Stand/Chase/Attack state machine driven by distance and trigger area. States drive animator via `enemyAnim.SetInteger("EnemyState", ...)`.
- **Bug — `enemyAnim` can be null:** `ToAnimator()` calls `enemyAnim.SetInteger` with no null check; if the animator isn't assigned, every frame throws NRE.
- **Logic hole — standing attack:** `Attack` state never transitions back. `ResetToStand()` exists but is never called anywhere in the codebase (dead method). If the player stays in range, `state` remains `Attack` but `Update` re-enters the first branch since `state != Attack` guard prevents it — so after the first attack, enemy stays in `Attack` state until player leaves trigger, then `OnTriggerExit2D` resets to Stand.
- **After attack the enemy never chases again while staying within the same trigger** — the `Attack` branch doesn't set `enmity` or chunks. When player walks out, trigger resets it, but if the player stays inside range, only one attack is done and no second attempt (state stuck in Attack).
- **`ChaseTurn` direction vector**: moving directly toward player in all directions, fine for 2D top-down.
- **Knockback pattern:** same coroutine-based "lock movement" as `PlayerMove` — `isAttacked` flag suppresses all Update logic while stunned.
- **Tag comparison:** uses `collision.gameObject.tag == "Player"`; Unity recommends `CompareTag` (allocates less, avoids exceptions for missing tags).
- `distance` initialized to 10 — is it preset to equal default `attackRange`? Not necessarily; before player enters trigger, `distance` 10 > attackRange 1.5, so fine.
- Start() sets `facingDirection` from `transform.localScale.x` — assumes initial flip in Inspector rather than rotation.
